notice.message: A twenty-fourth local commit, 6054d0b, hides the decorative checkmark on the selected iPhone Settings language row. The checkmark stays visible, VoiceOver uses the existing language title, and the selected trait still follows the stored language. The owner tip remains 363ae84. That tip changes this same file only by moving the offline acceptance banner. This hunk is the language rows and does not touch that banner, so this lane did not rebase. This lane did not push, merge, deploy, acquire the native slot, or start xcodebuild or gradle.
notice.owner_tip_other_native_file: apple/AhmadCareer/NativeCareerViews.swift still differs from 3a08819 to 363ae84. That change moves the offline UI acceptance banner. This slice edits the Settings language rows in the same file, outside that banner. The language-row context matches the tip once these two modifiers are removed. This lane did not rebase and did not edit the banner.

twenty_fourth_commit.subject: Hide the selected language checkmark from VoiceOver
twenty_fourth_commit.single_patch_apply_check: git apply --check of the format-patch onto detached ee3bac2 in a temporary worktree. FORMAT_APPLY_CHECK_OK. The working-tree diff was also apply-checked onto that parent before the commit. Not a twenty-four-patch series apply.

product_in_6054d0b.language_checkmark: Settings language rows still draw a visible checkmark on the stored language. That image is accessibilityHidden, and the button accessibility label is the existing title: Device language, English, or العربية. Arabic already maps Device language to لغة الجهاز. English and العربية stay those names. The selected trait is still added only on the stored row. No new localization key was added.
product_in_6054d0b.left_quiet: Appearance rows already hid the same symbol and already set the same kind of label. This commit does not move the offline acceptance banner. Android language and appearance rows are radio buttons in MainActivity.kt, which this lane did not edit.
product_in_6054d0b.residual: This was not a VoiceOver pass. swiftc -parse only checked syntax. The owner tip still moves the banner in this file. Applying this series onto 243031d does not include that banner move, because this lane did not rebase.

checks.6054d0b_diff_check: git diff --check on NativeCareerViews.swift before commit. No whitespace errors, exit 0.
checks.6054d0b_decision_probe: A host-side Python replica read the language rows and the English and Arabic string tables and exited 0. The probe counted 120 assertions: the rows sit outside the banner, only the stored language draws a checkmark, that checkmark is out of the accessibility tree, the selected trait follows the stored language, and each stored choice among system, English, and Arabic checks every row in both languages. Not a VoiceOver, XCTest, or device test.
checks.6054d0b_parse: xcrun --sdk macosx swiftc -parse apple/AhmadCareer/NativeCareerViews.swift printed PARSE_OK. Syntax only. Not an iOS build and not xcodebuild.
checks.6054d0b_apply_check: Format-patch apply --check onto ee3bac2. FORMAT_APPLY_CHECK_OK. The twenty-four-patch series was not applied.
checks.owner_tip: Fetched origin/recovery/publishing-integrated-20261117-d57f4 before the commit. FETCH_HEAD remained 363ae84. The owner diff from 243031d in apple and android is still only NativeCareerViews.swift. The language-row context matches that tip. This lane did not rebase.
checks.catalog: Localizable.strings, native-copy.json, and career_copy.xml were not edited. No new spoken sentence was added.
checks.not_run: No xcodebuild, gradle, kotlinc, device, VoiceOver, or UI test run.

notice.independent_review: No separate reviewer was spawned. Do not treat this notice as an independent pass.
notice.suggested_owner_check: Apply the patches through ee3bac2 as recorded in the 21:09 notice, then apply 6054d0b-Hide-the-selected-language-checkmark-from-VoiceOver.patch. The owner tip is 363ae84 and this lane did not rebase onto it. This hunk is outside the banner that tip moves. This lane must not take the native build slot.
